arxiv-1903-02117.title: Random minibatch subgradient algorithms for convex problems with functional constraints
arxiv-1903-02117.creator: Angelia Nedić, Ion Necoara
arxiv-1903-02117.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Angelia Nedić, Ion Necoara. In this paper we consider non-smooth convex optimization problems with (possibly) infinite intersection of constraints. In contrast to the classical approach, where the constraints are usually represented as intersection of simple sets, which are easy to project onto, in this paper we consider that each constraint set is given as the level set of a convex but not necessarily differentiable function. For these settings we propose subgradient iterative algorithms with random minibatch feasibility updates.

arxiv-2109-00787.title: Factorization method for inverse time-harmonic elastic scattering with a single plane wave
arxiv-2109-00787.creator: Guanqiu Ma, Guanghui Hu
arxiv-2109-00787.description: Abstract This paper is concerned with the factorization method with a single far-field pattern to recover an arbitrary convex polygonal scatterer/source in linear elasticity. The approach also applies to the compressional (resp. shear) part of the far-field pattern excited by a single compressional (resp. shear) plane wave.

arxiv-2203-01550.title: A Characterization of Multiclass Learnability
arxiv-2203-01550.creator: Nataly Brukhim, Daniel Carmon, Irit Dinur, Shay Moran, Amir Yehudayoff
arxiv-2203-01550.description: Abstract . A seminal result in learning theory characterizes the PAC learnability of binary classes through the Vapnik-Chervonenkis dimension. Extending this characterization to the general multiclass setting has been open since the pioneering works on multiclass PAC learning in the late 1980s.

arxiv-2304-13300.title: Near-video frame rate quantum sensing using Hong-Ou-Mandel interferometry
arxiv-2304-13300.creator: Sandeep Singh, Vimlesh Kumar, Varun Sharma, Daniele Faccio, G. K. Samanta
arxiv-2304-13300.description: Abstract Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) interference, the bunching of two indistinguishable photons on a balanced beam-splitter, has emerged as a promising tool for quantum sensing. There is a need for wide spectral-bandwidth photon pairs (for high-resolution sensing) with high brightness (for fast sensing).

arxiv-2305-02228.title: Explicit spectral gap for Hecke congruence covers of arithmetic Schottky surfaces
arxiv-2305-02228.creator: Louis Soares

Let Γ \Gamma be a Schottky subgroup of SL 2 ​ ( ℤ ) \mathrm{SL}_{2}(\mathbb{Z}) and let X = Γ \ ℍ 2 X=\Gamma\backslash\mathbb{H}^{2} be the associated hyperbolic surface. arxiv-2305-11673.title: Bias Beyond English: Counterfactual Tests for Bias in Sentiment Analysis in Four Languages
arxiv-2305-11673.creator: Seraphina Goldfarb-Tarrant, †, Adam Lopez †, Diego Marcheggiani ‡, roiblan@amazon.com, marchegg@amazon.com
arxiv-2305-11673.description: Abstract Sentiment analysis (SA) systems are used in many products and hundreds of languages. Gender and racial biases are well-studied in English SA systems, but understudied in other languages, with few resources for such studies. To remedy this, we build a counterfactual evaluation corpus for gender and racial/migrant bias in four languages.

arxiv-2307-15734.title: Collinear fragmentation at NNLL: generating functionals, groomed correlators and angularities Preprint: CERN-TH-2023-143, OUTP-23-08P
arxiv-2307-15734.creator: Melissa van Beekveld, Mrinal Dasgupta, Basem Kamal El-Menoufi, Jack Helliwell, and Pier Francesco Monni
arxiv-2307-15734.description: Abstract Jet calculus offers a unique mathematical technique to bridge the area of QCD resummation with Monte Carlo parton showers. With the ultimate goal of constructing next-to-next-to-leading logarithmic (NNLL) parton showers we study, using the language of generating functionals, the collinear fragmentation of final-state partons.

arxiv-2401-03695.title: A Large-Scale Empirical Study on Improving the Fairness of Image Classification Models DOI: 10.1145/3650212.3652122 issta24main-p445-p ISBN: 979-8-4007-0612-7/24/09 Conference: Proceedings of the 33rd ACM SIGSOFT International Symposium on Software Testing and Analysis; September 16–20, 2024; Vienna
arxiv-2401-03695.creator: Junjie Yang, Jiajun Jiang, Zeyu Sun, Junjie Chen
arxiv-2401-03695.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Junjie Yang, Jiajun Jiang, Zeyu Sun, Junjie Chen. Fairness has been a critical issue that affects the adoption of deep learning models in real practice. To improve model fairness, many existing methods have been proposed and evaluated to be effective in their own contexts. However, there is still no systematic evaluation among them for a comprehensive comparison under the same context, which makes it hard to understand the performance distinction among them, hindering the research progress and practical adoption of them.

arxiv-2401-07736.title: Coupled vertical double quantum dots at single-hole occupancy
arxiv-2401-07736.creator: Alexander S. Ivlev, Hanifa Tidjani, Stefan D. Oosterhout, Amir Sammak, Giordano Scappucci, Menno Veldhorst
arxiv-2401-07736.description: Abstract Gate-defined quantum dots define an attractive platform for quantum computation and have been used to confine individual charges in a planar array. Here, we demonstrate control over vertical double quantum dots confined in a strained germanium double quantum well . We sense individual charge transitions with a single-hole transistor.

arxiv-2403-15108.title: Active Learning for Regression based on Wasserstein distance and GroupSort Neural Networks
arxiv-2403-15108.creator: Bobbia Benjamin, Picard Matthias
arxiv-2403-15108.description: Abstract This paper addresses a new active learning strategy for regression problems. The presented Wasserstein active regression model is based on the principles of distribution-matching to measure the representativeness of the labeled dataset. The Wasserstein distance is computed using GroupSort Neural Networks.

arxiv-2406-04055.title: Leveraging SPD Matrices on Riemannian Manifolds in Quantum-Classical Hybrid Models for Structural Health Monitoring
arxiv-2406-04055.creator: Azadeh Alavi 1 1 , Sanduni Jayasinghe 2
arxiv-2406-04055.description: Abstract Real-time finite element modeling (FEM) of bridges assists modern structural health monitoring systems by providing comprehensive insights into structural integrity. This capability is essential for ensuring the safe operation of bridges and preventing sudden catastrophic failures. However, FEM’s computational cost and the need for real-time analysis pose significant challenges.

arxiv-2505-06293.title: Classifying Inconsistency in AHP Pairwise Comparison Matrices Using Machine Learning
arxiv-2505-06293.creator: Amarnath Bose
arxiv-2505-06293.description: Abstract Assessing consistency in Pairwise Comparison Matrices (PCMs) within the Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) poses significant challenges when using the traditional Consistency Ratio (CR) method. This study introduces a novel alternative that leverages triadic preference reversals (PR) to provide a more robust and interpretable assessment of consistency.

arxiv-2508-21167.title: RARR : Robust Real-World Activity Recognition with Vibration by Scavenging Near-Surface Audio Online
arxiv-2508-21167.creator: Dong Yoon Lee, Alyssa Weakley, Hui Wei, Blake Brown, Keyana Carrion, Shijia Pan
arxiv-2508-21167.description: Abstract . One in four people dementia live alone, leading family members to take on caregiving roles from a distance. Many researchers have developed remote monitoring solutions to lessen caregiving needs; however, limitations remain including privacy preserving solutions, activity recognition, and model generalizability to new users and environments.

arxiv-2509-03575.title: Ferromagnetism vs. Antiferromagnetism in Narrow-Band Systems: Competition Between Quantum Geometry and Band Dispersion
arxiv-2509-03575.creator: Haoyu Hu, Oskar Vafek, Kristjan Haule, B. Andrei Bernevig
arxiv-2509-03575.description: Abstract Magnetism in narrow-band systems arises from the interplay between electronic correlations, quantum geometry, and band dispersion. In particular, both ferro and anti-ferro magnets are known to occur as ground states of (different) models featuring narrow bands. This poses the question of which is favored and under what conditions.

pmc-10744856.description: The genus Gongronella is important in agriculture and industry by secreting various natural bioactive metabolites such as chitosanases and organic acids. During the most recent 8 years, a total of 14 new species have been described, remarkably enriching the diversity of this genus.

The present study analyzed the interplay of trait and state self-control and time perception tendencies (time overestimation vs.

pmc-11359158.title: Permanent Stress Adaptation and Unexpected High Light Tolerance in the Shade-Adapted Chlamydomonas priscui
pmc-11359158.creator: Devon Popson, Susanna D’Silva, Kaylie Wheeless, Rachael Morgan-Kiss, Bernhard Huchzermeyer
pmc-11359158.description: The Antarctic photopsychrophile, Chlamydomonas priscui UWO241, is adapted to extreme environmental conditions, including permanent low temperatures, high salt, and shade. During long-term exposure to this extreme habitat, UWO241 appears to have lost several short-term mechanisms in favor of constitutive protection against environmental stress.

pmc-11414673.title: The protective effect of luteolin on cadmium induced liver intestinal toxicity in chicken by Gut-liver axis regulation
pmc-11414673.creator: Hui Zou, Waseem Ali, Kai Deng, Yan Chen, Jian Sun, Tao Wang, Yonggang Ma, Zongping Liu
pmc-11414673.description: Environmental pollution poses a significant challenge to the poultry industry, leading to substantial losses and adverse effects on the health, production, and performance of avian species. In recent years, there has been growing interest in exploring natural compounds with potential protective effects against cadmium (Cd)-induced toxicity.

pmc-12358622.title: Development of a dual-port wideband MIMO antenna for Sub-7 GHz 5G applications
pmc-12358622.creator: Prem Pal Singh, Vishal Sorathiya, Abdulkarem H. M. Almawgani, Adam R. H. Alhawari
pmc-12358622.description: This research introduces a two-port MIMO antenna suitable for 5G, demonstrating enhanced data rates, throughput, capacity, and resistance to multipath fading. The antenna operates within the sub-7 GHz frequency range and adheres to the standards for 5G connections employed in many countries. The antenna possesses a wideband response spanning from 3.7 to 7.

pmc-12525000.title: Usp21 Knockout Causes Abnormal Lipid Metabolism in Mouse and Its Polymorphism Correlates with Hypercholesterolemia in Outpatients
pmc-12525000.creator: Sailakshmi Iyer, Naoko Hattori, Hiroshi Okuda, Takeya Nakagawa, Satoshi Fujii, Takahiro Maeda, Haruhiko Koseki, Takashi Ito
pmc-12525000.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Usp21, a member of the ubiquitin protease family, plays a vital role in various biological functions. However, the effects of Usp21 dysfunction remain incompletely understood. In this study, we generated Usp21 knockout (KO) mice. Blood tests showed no impairment of liver function but did reveal elevated levels of total cholesterol (T-CHOL) and free fatty acid (FFA) in Usp21 KO mice compared to wild-type (WT) mice. Next, we performed RNA-sequencing (RNA-seq) to identify genes that Usp21 regulates.

pmc-12659226.title: Capturing the wider benefits from football participation: a social return on investment (SROI) evaluation of a community based football intervention
pmc-12659226.creator: Steve Daly, Tom Egan, Paula Carroll, Gillian Curran, Michael Harrison, Aisling McGrath, Laura Finnegan, Noel Richardson, Peter Krustrup
pmc-12659226.description: BackgroundGendered approaches to engage men are recommended for health promotion, with community settings, that involve physical activity and specifically football being frequently employed. One such football initiative, Football Cooperative (FC), has operated in Ireland since 2017 bringing men together twice a week for ‘pick up’ games.

pmc-13085699.title: Effect of some PGPR (Plant Growth Promoting Bacteria) combinations on some soil properties and horticultural characteristics in Albion and Monterey strawberry cultivars
pmc-13085699.creator: Muhammed Kupe, Fazıl Hacimuftuoglu, Fatih Dadasoglu
pmc-13085699.description: Strawberry is a temperate fruit specie grown all year round in both open and protected cultivation around the world and consumed with pleasure by consumers for its extraordinary appearance and rich taste and aroma. Like other berries, strawberries are highly suitable for environmentally friendly treatments and benefits greatly from these practices.

pmc-13295704.title: Explainable Quality Assessment and Measurement from Real-World Hip Ultrasound Cine Sweeps
pmc-13295704.creator: Adam McArthur, Stephanie Wichuk, Stephen Burnside, George Reed, Sukhdeep Dulai, Abhilash Hareendranathan, Jacob L. Jaremko
pmc-13295704.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study evaluates Retuve, an open-source explainable pipeline for the automated analysis of infant hip ultrasound cine sweeps. Retuve combines segmentation, Graf-plane calibration, and frame filtering. In a retrospective multicenter study, we tested the full pipeline on an external set of 109 hips from a Canadian community clinic, with internal developmental validation of segmentation on 90 hips and Graf-plane calibration on 419 hips.

pmc-13388958.title: Mesoporous peptide frameworks engineered from crystallizable collagen-mimetic peptide amphiphiles
pmc-13388958.creator: Anthony R Perez, Jianfang Liu, S M Mobin Sikder, Anjan Maity, Adekunle Adewole, Jacob Oakden, Gang Ren, Bercem Dutagaci, Andrea D Merg
pmc-13388958.description: The rational design of porous frameworks with tunable pore dimensions and chemical functionalities is a critical step toward their implementation in diverse applications. While traditional porous materials are typically constructed from abiotic components, there is increasing interest in employing biologically derived building blocks (e.g., peptides and proteins) that offer unmatched structural and functional diversity.
